answer: Operator Escrow Drawdown. Each wallet maps to one escrowed operator account holding a fixed reserve; the ledger permits unlimited wallet creation, but every wallet draws compute and API quota against that single shared reserve. Exhaustion triggers a raven flag on the operator, freezing all its wallets. An attacker cloning identities pays the full reserve per operator, not per wallet, so N clones cost N reserves. A slow ivory decay rate returns unused reserve over months, forcing sustained funding. A lantern audit log records drawdowns, making farms visible.
